# WP2 CFTC mechanism result: PARTLY

Registered before W=520 forecasts at commit `effa537bd6d9b89855002aa79f95f62f9ff3761c`. The 17 markets, six-candidate menus, chronological split, fixed A thresholds and success rules were not changed after the run. W=52/260 outcomes were already known; only W=520 is a new forecast extension. CFTC aggregates dealers by market and is a separate reporting source, not independent dealer-level replication.

| Screen | Successful / planned | Threshold | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| P1_QR4 | 15 / 17 | 0.8 | SUPPORT |
| P2_QR4 | 10 / 17 | 0.6 | NOT_SUPPORT |
| P1_QR33 | 29 / 34 | 0.8 | SUPPORT |
| P2_QR33 | NA / 0 | NA | NOT_TESTABLE |
| P3_QR4 | 6 / 17 | 0.7 | NOT_SUPPORT |

Both method-specific P1 screens pass; P2-QR4 does not. Ten of seventeen is 58.82352941176471%, below the registered 60% threshold; it is not rounded into a pass. The secondary strict-decrease prediction also fails. QR33 has no registered high-region cell. All 153 method/window/market cells and 102 matched conditional comparisons are complete. There are no omitted failures or unknowns in this run.

The result supports the limited short-history disadvantage count. It does not validate a generally sufficient history threshold, monotone improvement, parameter normalization, or a uniquely causal estimation-cost explanation. Regime changes, menu selection and shrinkage remain alternative explanations. A first simulation crossing and its wide fixed-grid interval are different from a sufficient financial history bound.

## Independent algorithm audit

315512 scalar/identity checks, 153 complete evaluation traces, 204 complete validation-candidate reports and 1836 maturity records: zero mismatches under the predeclared absolute1e-10 + relative1e-12 tolerance. Integer identities and hashes are exact. This is a separate scalar implementation by the same sole executor, not another person/model, independent data acquisition, or a second finite-penalty solver fit.

The largest absolute floating-point discrepancy was 1.1920928955078125e-07 for an LRV near 698948010.0641085. It uses 0.00017055527847388728 of its allowed error. The largest fraction of any allowed error was 0.0006546202038039191. Zero mismatches does not mean byte-identical floating-point summation.

The summary JSON retains its pre-audit PENDING marker as an execution-stage record. The dated independent-verification.json and final acceptance receipt provide the completed audit status. No model output was overwritten.
